Subject: Offer economics: L4 SWE (Arianna Morales) — request for band check

Team —

Following my sync with Markus yesterday, we want to extend a standard L4 SWE offer to Arianna Morales (starts target: 2026-09-20). Candidate is a strong backend engineer with prior infra experience; she received an external counteroffer that included a $25k sign-on.

Proposed package (initial worksheet attached):
- Base: $165,000
- Target bonus: 12% annual
- Equity: 14,000 RSUs (4y vest, standard cliff) — ask: place at band midpoint
- One-time sign-on request: $30,000 (requested by hiring manager to offset counter)
- Start date: 2026-09-20 (flexible)
- Cost center: ENG-PLATFORM-22 (pending confirmation)

Can comp/legal/finance confirm:
1) This sits within our L4 band for SF region (base + bonus + equity appetite).
2) Approvals needed for a $30k sign-on (finance threshold? exec signoff?).
3) Any reason to adjust equity quantum from 14k to midpoint guideline?

Attached: 2026-08-10_arianna_offer_workbook.xlsx (worksheet with comps and benchmarking).

Thanks — I need a quick decision today to avoid losing her.

— Lauren
Head of Product, Search
Redwood Inference

Lauren —

Thanks, saw the worksheet. A couple quick clarifying questions before I stamp: 
- Vesting: confirm standard 4y with 1y cliff? I'll put that in the offer template.
- Equity sizing: 14,000 RSUs looks slightly above midpoint for L4 in SF (~12k midpoint). Do you have a note on comp mix preference (cash vs equity)?
- Sign-on: $30k is above our usual one-time sign-on guidance for L4; typically finance approval required >$25k.

If Markus is comfortable with the rationale, I can prepare the offer using the standard-offer-template.pdf and flag sign-on for finance approval. Attaching the template.

Folks —

Quick band/context note from recruiting:
- Candidate has 6.5 years total exp, two years in systems infra at a large cloud provider, comparable to previous L4 hires.
- Market comp for similar candidates in SF Q2 2026: base range $150k–$175k, midpoint ~$162k; RSU midpoint ~12k–14k depending on tenure.

Recommendation:
- Keep base at $165k (solid mid-point), 12% target bonus is fine.
- Equity: 14,000 RSUs is defensible given prior infra experience; if comp wants exact midpoint we can reduce to 12k but that may impact acceptance.
- Sign-on: candidate indicates counteroffer includes $25k cash. Manager requests $30k to ensure acceptance. If finance caps at $25k, we should consider increasing equity or improving first-year bonus payout structure instead.

Link to HubSpot candidate record and interview feedback: https://hubspot.example.com/contact/5257
